courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 列車自動洗車機
related.transfer: 可遷移「坡高與重力能量帳」與「區段軸數與未知狀態」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；列車自動洗車機的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Height drop and gravitational energy" and "Section axle balance and unknown state" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Automatic train-washing plants must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速；列車自動洗車機則以自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control; Automatic train-washing plants centres on water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「坡高與重力能量帳」與「噴洗水量與清水補充」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到列車自動洗車機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「車體偵測到設備退讓」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Height drop and gravitational energy” and “Spray volume and freshwater makeup”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Automatic train-washing plants, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 貨運編組場駝峰調速
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用動能差與平均耗能力及車組任務與路徑狀態連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force and wagon-group assignments and route states. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
